card.name: OR/OTHER in all-caps warning headings
card.fires_on: The words OR and OTHER in capitalized boxed-warning headings, right before a group noun such as OTHER CNS DEPRESSANTS or OTHER RISK FACTORS.

modes.label: OR before OTHER
modes.description: The word OR after BENZODIAZEPINES in an all-caps warning list.
modes.example: RISKS FROM CONCOMITANT USE WITH BENZODIAZEPINES<< OR>> OTHER CNS DEPRESSANTS

modes.label: OTHER after a drug and list word
modes.description: The word OTHER after CODEINE AND or after a drug name and comma, before a group noun.
modes.example: ULTRA-RAPID METABOLISM OF CODEINE AND<< OTHER>> RISK FACTORS FOR LIFE-TH

card.writes: It promotes words like species, fauna and wildlife, which does not fit the text, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the little words OR and OTHER in capitalized warning headings that lead into a group such as other depressants.
